messages:
alicia (support): Hey team — escalation from AcmeCorp (ticket #AC-4432). Their A/B rollout dashboard shows Variant labels swapped and counts off compared to their backend logs. Customer says this started after we pushed the new rollout-ui last night. Screenshot attached in ticket. :worried:
john.doe (customer): Confirming — our backend shows 62% -> variant_blue and 38% -> variant_orange, but your dashboard is showing the reverse. This is impacting a live experiment. We saw the change around 03:10 UTC.
derrick (eng): @alicia can you paste the exact org + experiment id and a quick sample of the events? Also did they have any custom bucketing keys recently? :eyes:
alicia (support): Experiment id exp_2026_04_acme. Customer sent sample events (redacted):
```json
{"timestamp":"2026-04-04T03:09:58Z","user_id":"u-129","assignment_key":"email:acme.com","variant_id":"variant_blue","sample_rate":0.8}
{"timestamp":"2026-04-04T03:10:02Z","user_id":"u-130","assignment_key":"email:acme.com","variant_id":"variant_orange","sample_rate":0.8}
```
alicia (support): They also attached a screenshot from our rollout UI showing swapped labels at 03:12 UTC.
nina (oncall): Ops: checked ingest logs for exp_2026_04_acme around 03:00-03:30 UTC. There was a small spike in dropped events from the frontend proxy between 03:08-03:11 (rate-limited). Deploy bot shows rollout-ingest v2 deployed at 02:55 UTC.
ops-bot: rollout-ingest v2 deployed by deployer-ci at 2026-04-04T02:55:12Z.
derrick (eng): Interesting — the frontend includes a sample_rate field; our ingest pipeline expects always-normalized sample_rate = 1.0 and applies an upweighting step in aggregation. If some events had sample_rate=0.8 and others had sample_rate omitted, that could change the effective totals if we double-count or apply weight in the wrong direction. Can you paste the aggregation SQL we use for the dashboard?
alicia (support): From our docs, the dashboard query is roughly:
```sql
SELECT variant_id, SUM(weight) as count
FROM assignments
WHERE experiment_id='exp_2026_04_acme' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-04T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-04T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY variant_id;
-- weight is computed at ingest as 1.0/sample_rate
```
derrick (eng): Ok — hypothesis: rollout-ingest v2 introduced a bug where weight was computed as sample_rate instead of 1.0/sample_rate for records that include sample_rate. That would invert counts for records coming from the new SDK path vs old path.
maria (product): If true, that would explain sudden flips immediately after deploy. We need scope: how many customers and experiments affected? Also prioritize a backfill for this customer.
nina (oncall): I triggered a quick check:
```bash
# count of events with sample_rate present vs absent
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_assignments WHERE experiment_id='exp_2026_04_acme' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-04T02:45:00Z' AND '2026-04-04T03:30:00Z' AND sample_rate IS NOT NULL;
```
nina (oncall): Result: 1,420 events with sample_rate present, 4,780 without in that window.
derrick (eng): Ok confirmed locally by running a mini-sim: if we treat weight = sample_rate we undercount — for sample_rate 0.8 you'd report 0.8 instead of 1.25. If majority of assignments came from instrumented calls with omitted sample_rate, the math can flip percentages depending on which variant had more instrumented clients.
john.doe (customer): Anything we can do from our side? We can pause the experiment but that hurts our rollout.
derrick (eng): Short-term: we can push a hotfix to ingest logic to compute weight = 1.0 / sample_rate when sample_rate > 0 and fallback to 1.0 when missing. I have a PR ready to apply the fix. I'll coordinate with @nina for a canary deploy.
ops-bot: canary-deploy rollout-ingest v2.1 to prod-canary (1 node) queued.
nina (oncall): Canary up at 03:48 UTC. I validated weight computation on canary against golden sample — looks correct.
derrick (eng): Running a re-aggregate job for exp_2026_04_acme from 03:00-03:30 with corrected weights now.
```sql
INSERT INTO aggregates.backfill_run (experiment_id, started_by, note) VALUES ('exp_2026_04_acme','derrick','weight-fix-backfill');
CALL aggregates.recompute('exp_2026_04_acme','2026-04-04T03:00:00Z','2026-04-04T03:30:00Z');
```
derrick (eng): Backfill completed. Dashboard values for AcmeCorp now match their logs: variant_blue ~62% variant_orange ~38%.
alicia (support): Customer updated their ticket: thanks, numbers look correct now. They asked for an RCA and whether other customers were affected.
derrick (eng): Quick blast-radius check: the new code path was enabled for SDKs >= 1.9.2 and only on rollout-ingest v2. From logs, ~12 customers had mixed sample_rate present in the affected window. I'll run a batch reprocess for all experiments touching that ingest shard between 02:50-03:20.
maria (product): OK prioritize: (1) notify customers impacted (support to prepare template), (2) run full backfill for affected windows, (3) patch release and rollout validation, (4) RCA doc with timeline.
alicia (support): I'll start the notification draft and ping legal/comms for wording. Customer asked if we can add a guard in dashboard to show "recomputed/understanding" state — maybe a small banner.
derrick (eng): Agree — also adding an automated unit test to ensure weight = 1/sample_rate and an e2e test covering mixed-sample-rate streams.
john.doe (customer): Appreciate the fast fix. Can you confirm whether we need to re-run any analysis on our side?
alicia (support): No action needed from AcmeCorp. We'll email once backfill is complete (done) and include the before/after numbers we computed.
maria (product): Leaving this open until RCA + postmortem. Assigning to derrick for the write-up and to ops for the runbook update.
derrick (eng): Will post RCA by EOD. Key takeaway: breaking change in sample_rate weight computation in rollout-ingest v2 — caused incorrect assignment tallies for experiments with mixed instrumentation. Mitigation: hotfix + backfill + tests.
alicia (support): Closing the customer ticket after confirmation. :white_check_mark:
